summary: Auto-executing.pth harvests host state and GCP credentials, exfiltrates to hardcoded IP
details: The package ships bq_helix_recon.pth plus sitecustomize.py/usercustomize.py that invoke bootstrap() on every Python interpreter start — including pip's own subsequent interpreter invocations immediately after install — with no import or user action required. The bootstrap payload collects the full process environment (dict(os.environ)), hostname/uid/user, /proc/self/* entries (cmdline, status, cgroup, mountinfo, net/tcp, fds, namespaces), and walks /, /workspace, /root, /home, and /tmp. It also queries the GCE metadata server at 169.254.169.254 for instance/service-accounts/default/token and reads credential files including /root/.docker/config.json, application_default_credentials.json, and the file referenced by GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS. The collected data is POSTed in cleartext to http://34.45.253.92:8080/bq-helix-recon-6ade983e and sent over TCP to 34.45.253.92:1234. SystemExit is raised in non-runtime phases to further ensure persistent recon execution.
